checkAndSwitchMode().details: Call path: Gateway/InteractionPool/any caller -> TradingModeController.checkAndSwitchMode -> TradingModeController._checkAndSwitchMode. The method is intentionally permissionless.

configureTradingRouter(address).details: Call path: Deploy._configure/owner -> TradingModeController.configureTradingRouter. This is one-time only.

prepareSale().details: Call path: user -> TradingRouter.sellMob -> TradingModeController.prepareSale. Only the configured TradingRouter proxy may call it; no switch is performed until the completed sale is accounted for.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

recordPairSaleAndCheck(uint256).details: Call path: user -> TradingRouter.sellMob -> TradingModeController.recordPairSaleAndCheck -> TradingModeController._checkAndSwitchMode. Only the configured TradingRouter proxy may call it.

setFlowSwitchThresholds(uint256,uint256).details: Call path: operator -> TradingModeController.setFlowSwitchThresholds. Values apply immediately.

setPriceRecoveryThresholds(uint256,uint2.details: Call path: operator -> TradingModeController.setPriceRecoveryThresholds. Values apply immediately.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

checkAndSwitchMode().notice: Evaluates current balances, accumulated pool flow and active Pair recovery conditions.

configureTradingRouter(address).notice: Connects the only TradingRouter proxy allowed to submit completed Pair-sale outflow.

constructor.notice: Locks the implementation and records immutable mode dependencies used by every proxy call.

getTradingModeStatus().notice: Returns every current balance, window, threshold result and applicable switch signal in O(1) reads.

isPairMode().notice: Returns whether MÖB sales currently execute through the external Pair.

prepareSale().notice: Rolls expired flow windows before TradingRouter snapshots the mode used for one sale.

recordPairSaleAndCheck(uint256).notice: Records a completed Pair-mode MÖB sale and then evaluates the active recovery rules.

setFlowSwitchThresholds(uint256,uint256).notice: Updates the one-day gross outflow and seven-day net outflow thresholds for pool-to-Pair switching.

setOperator(address).notice: Sets the operator that may update the four percentage thresholds.

setPriceRecoveryThresholds(uint256,uint2.notice: Updates the recovered-price and price-drop thresholds for flow-triggered Pair mode.
